scope: Kiterlin anti-defensive-writing revision of experimental_setup.tex and results.tex

edits.before: The comparison measures the complete configured systems; it does not equalize all retrieval and inference budgets.
edits.after: This comparison evaluates complete systems with their respective retrieval and inference budgets.
edits.reason: Positive scope preserves unequal configured budgets without defensive negation.

edits.after: The evaluation tests head transfer across seven configurations and complete controller performance on two MedRAG backbones.
edits.reason: Leads with the two questions that organize the evidence.

edits.before: The head's value is therefore better assessed together with the operation ablation...
edits.after: On the nine covered prescribing examples with remaining support, the constant control scores zero; the head improves over the original answer in five configurations, is unchanged in one, and declines in one.
edits.reason: States control, subset, reference, and result directly; retains constant None outperforming all seven full-category heads.

edits.before: This localized regression is retained in the main table alongside the larger-category gains.
edits.after: Deleted; exact 13-unit clinical consequence scores remain in their paragraph.
edits.reason: The numeric result conveys the regression without reporting that the paper retains it.

edits.before: More aggregation is not uniformly better
edits.after: Aggregation gains depend on the backbone
edits.reason: Section title leads with observed C3 heterogeneity; complete C2/C4/C5 and generated-aggregation findings remain.

edits.before: Agreement alone does not satisfy either measure.
edits.after: Each pair counts as correct only when both answers match their respective references.
edits.reason: Positive operational definition retains the difference between agreement and joint correctness.

edits.before: Its candidate-only and joint-selection counterparts likewise do not provide a consistent improvement over B.
edits.after: Its candidate-only and joint-selection counterparts score below B on both backbones.
edits.reason: Read the complete six-arm table to state the actual C2/C5 direction precisely.

necessary_evidence_preserved: Seven configurations / six families and two-backbone complete-controller scope.
All original numeral tokens in both files, including scores, samples, denominators, costs, intervals, bootstrap seed, and generation settings.
Benchmark overlap, reused extracted facts, saved contexts, and separate head versus full-system results.
Benchmark used for method development and bootstrap limited to variability within that benchmark.
Coverage-matched constant None wins R2 against all seven heads; nine remaining-support cases have five improvements, one tie, one decline.
M5/Qwen clinical R4 drops from 53.85 to 23.08 on 13 units; Llama remains 53.85.
C3 changes Llama by -1.81 and Qwen by +0.93; C2/C5 lower than B on both; expanded sampling creates more unavailable outputs.
A4 288 outputs remain limited to 24 supplied-model virtual profiles.
All component request counts, unavailable original retrieval costs, and inclusion of invalid outputs in denominators.
initial_revision_issue: An intermediate phrase described C2/C5 as mixed across backbones; review of the full six-arm table showed both are lower on both backbones. Corrected before delivery.
compilation: Not performed by section editor; parent task performs whole-manuscript build after all edits.
